title: Isthmus: Bridging Supervision Islands Restores Uncertainty and Stability in One-Step Flows
abstract: arXiv:2611.23616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-step flow maps are increasingly used as posterior samplers, where the point of sampling is the uncertainty that the samples carry. We find that the one-step sampler loses this uncertainty and becomes less stable. Compared with multi-step samples of the same network, its samples lose variance and decorrelate. Supervising the one-step jump directly makes this worse; the samples collapse further toward the conditional mean and break down when training is extended. We trace both failures to the locations where training places its pairs of start and end times. Only pairs on the diagonal of the time triangle receive targets from data, and the pair used for one-step sampling is either left unsupervised or supervised on an island, a set of pairs that the self-consistency identity does not connect to the diagonal, where the objective neither determines the one-step map nor anchors its training. translated_title: Isthmus（地峡）：桥接监督孤岛，恢复单步流的不确定性与稳定性
translated_abstract: 单步流映射日益被用作后验采样器，其采样的意义在于样本所携带的不确定性。我们发现单步采样器会丢失这种不确定性并变得不稳定。与同一网络的多步采样结果相比，其样本失去方差且失去相关性。直接监督单步跳跃会使问题更糟：样本进一步向条件均值坍缩，并且在延长训练时崩溃。我们将这两类失败追溯到训练中起始与结束时间对的放置位置。只有位于时间三角形对角线上的时间对才能从数据获得目标，而用于单步采样的时间对要么完全没有监督，要么被监督在一座“孤岛”上——即一组未被自洽恒等式连接到对角线的时间对，此时目标函数既无法确定单步映射，也无法锚定其训练。我们用一条“地峡”来桥接这座孤岛（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示单步流采样因监督时间对落在与数据对角线断开的“监督孤岛”上而丢失不确定性与稳定性，并提出用“地峡”桥接孤岛以恢复单步流的不确定性和稳定性。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that one-step flow samplers lose uncertainty and stability because their supervision pairs lie on "supervision islands" disconnected from the data-supervised diagonal, and proposes bridging these islands with an "isthmus" to restore uncertainty and stability in one-step flows.
